_about: 0.4.0 (6 Nov 2026), GitHub issue 36: at the two-list dealers the right stick moves the list under the focus or the cursor, never the other one.

notes: RS moves the description while it overflows, then the list under the focus or the left stick's cursor; on a filter or the transfer panel the list last focused. A list that fits moves nothing.
